bibl.title: The scarab, from amulets to magical gems: transmissions and transpositions of an emblem of the pharaonic civilisation.
bibl.seg: Dominique Barcat, The scarab, from amulets to magical gems: transmissions and transpositions of an emblem of the pharaonic civilisation.

Electra Apostola & Christos Kekes (edd.), Current Research in Egyptology 2021. Proceedings of the Twenty-First Annual Symposium, University of the Aegean, 9-16 May 2021 (Oxford, 2022) pp. 214-236, figg.
